text: workflow : Construct baseline conditional genotype frequencies cases controls. Optionally apply locus heterogeneity cases \(g_{case,true} = \pi g_{case,base} + (1 - \pi) g_{ctrl,base}\). Optionally apply phenotype misclassification, theta = Pr(affected -> control) phi = Pr(unaffected -> case). Optionally apply genotype misclassification matrices resulting case control genotype frequencies. Compute genotype chi-square genotype trend-test MSSN values observed genotype frequencies. defaults (locus_het = FALSE, pheno_misclass = FALSE, geno_misclass = "none") give ordinary -error design. modifiers active, applied sequentially order therefore form one combined adjusted design. input_mode = "model_based", conditional case control genotype frequencies derived prev, pd, R2, MOI using Chapter 1, Section 1.4.2, Eqs. 1.6–1.7 (p. 13) Gordon, Finch, Kim (2020). input_mode = "model_free", user supplies g1 g0 directly; phenotype misclassification enabled, g1 treated true affected genotype distribution g0 treated true unaffected genotype distribution. Phenotype misclassification requires prev input modes disease prevalence used mix true affected unaffected genotype distributions observed case control genotype distributions. applied optional locus heterogeneity optional genotype misclassification. genotype misclassification models : "none" identity matrices, "1p" one symmetric error rate, "2p" adjacent homozygote/heterozygote heterozygote error rates, "3p" non-differential three-parameter matrix, "diff3p" separate case control three-parameter matrices. one-, two-, three-parameter matrices correspond textbook Eqs. 2.5, 2.6, 2.7 (pp. 57–58). "1p", package e probability adjacent -diagonal cell diagonal \(1-2e\); textbook Eq. 2.5 uses -diagonal \(\epsilon/2\), \(\epsilon=2e\). genotype test uses Eq. 1.22 (p. 26). trend test defined Eqs. 1.20–1.21 (p. 24) uses NCP Eq. 1.24 (p. 27). Locus heterogeneity follows Eq. 2.16 (p. 88): pi homogeneous fraction \(1-\pi\) heterogeneous fraction. trend-test construction corresponds Eqs. 5.29a–b (pp. 287–288). geno_misclass = "diff3p", diff_source = "explicit" uses case control error parameters exactly supplied. diff_source = "case", control parameters computed multiplying case parameters diff_multiplier. diff_source = "ctrl", case parameters computed multiplying control parameters diff_multiplier. geno_misclass = "diff3p", returned MSSNs nominal, asymptotic values evaluated usual chi-square critical value. Different case control error mechanisms can distort null distribution inflate type error. function independently recalibrate null distribution arbitrary differential genotyping error. Internal effect-size components S retained returned object validation debugging, printed clean verbose output.

text: function adjusts Transmission Disequilibrium Test (TDT) possible phenotype misclassification. \(\pi_{01} > 0\), fraction unaffected individuals incorrectly classified affected, inflating apparent transmission probability. expected transmission (\(gT^*\)) non-transmission (\(gNT^*\)) calculated : $$gT^* = p_d p_+ + \frac{D(p_T - \theta_1)C(1 - \pi_{01})}{\phi_1 + \pi_{01}\phi_0}$$ $$gNT^* = p_d p_+ + \frac{D(p_A - \theta_1)C(\pi_{01} - 1)}{\phi_1 + \pi_{01}\phi_0}$$ required number trios : $$N^* = \frac{\lambda^* (gT^* + gNT^*)}{2 (gT^* - gNT^*)^2}$$ Setting \(\pi_{01} = 0\) reproduces standard (non-misclassified) TDT.
